rationale: The divergent StopSign placement at indices 36 and 37 is currently inferred: nodes 1, 2 and 5 have the marker at 37 while node 3 has it at 36, so position 36 should hold a value on the former group. This revision reads index 36 on nodes 1, 2 and 5 so the receipt shows directly whether the logs differ at that index. All other fields and both comparisons stay unchanged.

experiment.revision_reason: Adds n1_k36, n2_k36 and n5_k36 to the safety event, the entry kind at index 36 on nodes 1, 2 and 5, alongside their existing accepted, decided and index-37 kinds. No other field or comparison changes.

scope.description: Same five-node lossy stress with seed 0xbe5466cf34e90c6c, reconfigure at action 450, 20 percent loss, node 3 trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags, entry kinds at 35 to 37 and the p4_gap invariant, run id 13. The safety event additionally reports the entry kind at index 36 on nodes 1, 2 and 5.
assumptions: If nodes 1, 2 and 5 hold a value at index 36 while node 3 holds the StopSign there, the logs differ at that index.
All samples are taken at the same end-of-run point.
No snapshots or trimming are involved.
excluded: Starting the next configuration, snapshots, flexible quorums, crash-restart and Byzantine participants.

experiment.prefix: Identical to randomized_reconfig_diagnose_lag with the node 3 trace, node 4 promise diagnostics, is_reconfigured flags, entry kinds, the p4_gap invariant and the accepted/decided/kind data for nodes 1, 2 and 5. The safety event gains n1_k36, n2_k36 and n5_k36 from nodes[0], nodes[1] and nodes[4] with the existing entry_status helper over read(36).

comparisons.description: Bounded convergence past the resend timeout: all nodes report the same decided index.
Decided index never exceeds the accepted index on the final leader: node 4's decided index minus its accepted index is zero.
